questions.question: What did Josiah do after the Book of the Law was found?
options: Fled the city before the Babylonians arrived
Raised heavy taxes in order to rebuild his palace
Did nothing at all and ignored the dire warning
Led sweeping reforms, destroying idols and altars
questions.answer: Led sweeping reforms, destroying idols and altars
